recommendation: Keep the core audit commit. If OO wants to verify or refine the R6 SupplyDelivery workflow text that implementers currently see, do that follow-up in HL7/oo-incubator rather than in the inactive core SupplyDelivery source.
issue_request: FHIR-46405 was an Applied OO change request for R6, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking to add SupplyDelivery workflow text about bulk supply movement, dispatch and reception, use of SupplyDelivery.stage to identify the represented workflow stage, return handling, and hospital-consumables example guidance.
initial_application: The request was applied by Jira-tagged commits 9f55f0ca5b and 7e8c964def in source/supplydelivery/supplydelivery-notes.xml, building on the FHIR-45506 workflow-considerations section from 49b77e9ffa. That legacy file now contains the requested bulk-supplies dispatch/reception paragraph, the SupplyDelivery.stage sentence, return-handling prose, and dispatch/reception examples including the hospital-consumables scenario.
additional_context: Commit 3b38b80cf2 later removed SupplyDelivery, SupplyRequest, and other OO resources from active source/fhir.ini resource metadata and changed current core narrative pages to point to the OO Incubator IG. Current source/fhir.ini has no active supplydelivery entry, while resourceguide.html and workflow.html link SupplyDelivery to https://build.fhir.org/ig/HL7/oo-incubator/StructureDefinition-SupplyDelivery.html. OO minutes confirm the FHIR-46405 vote, and no Zulip search results were found that conflict with the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: No core source was changed. The published commit is an empty external-repo audit because editing source/supplydelivery would only adjust inactive legacy source; the current implementer-facing SupplyDelivery target is outside this core checkout.
